shots.title: Suppress duplicate guard-explore guidance within a Codex/agent session (#382)
shots.notes: Replaced compressed duplicate explore reminders with true one-shot context. Added a guard-state fallback key for Codex hook payloads that omit session_id.

shots.title: Add a sprint phase update path for existing sprint state (#383)
shots.notes: Added slope sprint phase <phase> and made slope sprint start --number=N --phase=X update same-sprint state instead of no-oping.

shots.title: Sync workflow per-ticket and post-hole phases into sprint-state lifecycle (#383)
shots.notes: Mapped workflow plan_review to reviewing, per_ticket to implementing, and post/validate phases to scoring without downgrading later sprint-state phases.

shots.title: Add guard and workflow regressions for explore dedup and phase advancement (#382/#383)
shots.notes: Added focused explore guard regressions for session and no-session hook inputs plus workflow tests for lightweight and standard per-ticket phase transitions.

shots.title: Surface guard-pr-review as PostToolUse additional context instead of a dropped/block-style suggestion (#384)
shots.notes: Changed pr-review to return context-only guidance so PostToolUse emits additionalContext instead of a high-priority block-style suggestion. Added a formatter regression.

conditions.description: The active Codex session was still running old dist code until the CLI was rebuilt, so the old repeated explore reminders continued during implementation.

training.description: Guard de-duplication should suppress non-actionable repeats, not replace them with smaller repeated messages.
training.outcome: Explore guidance now returns no hook output after the first identical context in a session or fallback branch/sprint window.

training.description: Workflow state and sprint-state are separate contracts and must be bridged when guards depend on lifecycle phase.
training.outcome: Workflow commands now keep sprint-state aligned when execution enters implementation or scoring phases.

training.description: PostToolUse review nudges should be advisory context unless they truly need to stop the tool flow.
training.outcome: guard-pr-review now surfaces the post-PR review command as additionalContext, matching the visible reminder behavior intended by the workflow.

nutrition.description: Focused guard/workflow tests, typecheck, build, runtime smokes, full test suite, roadmap validation, and map check passed.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A clean repair of two related guard-noise issues before returning to plugin packaging.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When guard output appears in every tool response, test both the guard function and the installed CLI path because stale dist can mask the fix.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The existing de-duper was technically working but still emitted a repeated compressed reminder, which preserved the user's real noise problem.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: Move back to Codex plugin packaging with the runtime guard behavior quieter and phase-aware.

bunker_locations: Codex hook payloads may omit session_id; de-dup keys need a fallback that is stable enough to suppress repeats without silencing future sprint work.
Workflow execution phase and .slope/sprint-state.json phase can drift unless workflow commands explicitly synchronize the lifecycle state.
course_management_notes: Validation used pnpm vitest run tests/cli/guards/explore.test.ts tests/cli/sprint-workflow.test.ts tests/cli/guards/claim-required.test.ts, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, runtime dist smokes, pnpm test, slope roadmap validate, and slope map --check.
slope roadmap validate remains valid with pre-existing roadmap warnings; slope map --check is current with a sprint-currency warning from CODEBASE.md metadata.

slope review recommend was run against a temporary S98 Claude plan and recommended architect required plus code optional. A tracked stale Sprint 25 Claude plan was removed because it caused false recommendation targeting.
Issue #384 was added after the draft PR opened; the guard protocol regression now checks PostToolUse output shape directly.
